newsitem.title: USA: Borealis names Murphy president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Borealis names Murphy president, CEO.

text.p: Borealis Technology Corp, a maker of mobile computing products for sales force automation, Tuesday named John Murphy as its president and chief executive officer.
He replaces Peter Pitsker who was interim president and a board member. Pitsker will retain his seat on the company's board, the company said in a statement.

Murphy has over 20 years executive management, sales and marketing experience with large and emerging high-technology companies. Murphy will lead Borealis as it expands its focus from product development to sales and customer support.

Murphy was most recently president and chief executive of Oregon-based Prometheus Products Inc., a unit of Sierra Semiconductor Corp. Prior to Prometheus, he was president of Practical Peripherals, which had over 500 employees and revenues of $60 million in fiscal 1994.
He also spent spent nine years at Apple Computer Inc, where from 1992-1993 he was the vice president of operations of Apple USA.
